item.title: Implicit Judgments
item.description: Implicit Judgments Definition Implicit judgments are relevance labels derived from observed user behavior — clicks, add-to-cart, purchases, dwell time, and (as negative signals) impressions without interaction — rather than from explicit human annotation.

item.title: Search Evaluation
item.description: Search Evaluation Definition Search evaluation is the systematic process of measuring how well a search system serves user information needs.

item.title: Vespa
item.description: Vespa What They Build Vespa is an open-source big data serving engine originally developed by Yahoo and now maintained as an independent open-source project (vespa.ai).

item.title: Approximate Nearest Neighbor Search
item.description: Approximate Nearest Neighbor Search (ANN) Approximate Nearest Neighbor (ANN) search finds vectors close to a query vector without comparing against every vector in the dataset.

item.title: BM25
item.description: BM25 Definition BM25 (Best Match 25) is the dominant lexical retrieval algorithm — the scoring function behind Elasticsearch’s default relevance, Solr, Lucene, and most production search engines.

item.title: ColBERT
item.description: ColBERT Definition ColBERT (Colaborative BERT / Contextualized Late Interaction over BERT) is a neural retrieval model that represents queries and documents as sets of per-token vectors rather than single pooled vectors.

item.title: Dense Vector Retrieval
item.description: Dense Vector Retrieval Definition Dense vector retrieval uses dense numerical embeddings (produced by neural models) to represent queries and documents, then finds the most similar documents via approximate nearest neighbor (ANN) search.
